data.name: Jawad
data.gender_notes: Jawad is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Jawad is an Arabic name meaning 'generous', 'noble', or 'open-handed'. It reflects a personality rooted in kindness, giving, and honor. The name Jawad carries the meaning “Generous, Noble” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in English, Urdu, Arabic. Parents who choose Jawad usually hope their child will grow to embody generous, noble and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents divine generosity and a heart full of blessings — one who uplifts others through selfless giving.
data.etymology: Jawad belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Generous, Noble.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jawad total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_arabic.name: جواد
in_arabic.meaning: الجواد يعني كثير الخير و السخاء و الجود
in_arabic.long_meaning: الجواد من أسماء الله الحسنى، يعني كثير الخير و السخاء و الجود، و هو من الأسماء التي وردت في القرآن الكريم، و هو صفة من صفات الله تعالى، و يوحي بالسخاء و الكرم و العطاء

in_urdu.name: جواد
in_urdu.meaning: جواد کا مطلب ہے خیر و سخاء کا باعث
in_urdu.long_meaning: جواد ایک عربی نام ہے جس کا مطلب ہے خیر و سخاء کا باعث، یہ نام اللہ کے خوبصورت ناموں میں سے ایک ہے، اور یہ قرآن مجید میں ذکر ہوا ہے، یہ نام سخاء، كرم اور عطا کی صفت کو ظاہر کرتا ہے

in_hindi.name: जवाद
in_hindi.meaning: जवाद का अर्थ है उदारता और अच्छाई का स्रोत
in_hindi.long_meaning: जवाद एक अरबी नाम है जिसका अर्थ है उदारता और अच्छाई का स्रोत, यह नाम अल्लाह के सुंदर नामों में से एक है, और यह कुरआन में उल्लेखित है, यह नाम उदारता, दया और देने की विशेषता को दर्शाता है

in_pashto.name: جواد
in_pashto.meaning: جواد د خير او سخاوت معنی لري
in_pashto.long_meaning: جواد د عربي نوم دی چی د خير او سخاوت معنی لري، دا نوم د الله ښکلي نومونو څخه يو دی، او دا نوم په قرآن کریم کې ذکر شوی دی، دا نوم سخاوت، کرم او ورکړې ځانګړتیا څرګندوي

in_english.name: Jawad
in_english.meaning: Jawad means generous, charitable, and kind
in_english.long_meaning: Jawad is an Arabic name that means generous, charitable, and kind, it is one of the beautiful names of Allah, and it is mentioned in the Quran, it connotes the attributes of generosity, charity, and benevolence, and is associated with positive personality traits such as kindness, compassion, and munificence

pronunciation.pashto: په پښتو کې د تلفظ تفصیل (جواد)

data.cultural_impact: The name Jawad holds a significant cultural impact in the Islamic world, as its meaning embodies the essence of generosity and excellence, which are virtues highly valued in Islam. Jawad is a name often given to children in hopes that they will grow up to be magnanimous individuals, contributing positively to their communities through acts of kindness and benevolence.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Jawad holds deep significance as it is associated with the qualities of the Prophet Muhammad (SAW) who is famous for his generosity, mercy, and compassion towards all—especially towards the poor and needy. As Muslims, we strive to emulate these noble qualities of Prophet Muhammad (SAW), making the name Jawad a constant reminder of this spiritual endeavor.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Jawad symbolizes generosity, kindness, and unwavering loyalty. It is derived from the Arabic word 'jawd', meaning 'abundance' or 'riches'. The bearer of this name is believed to embody these virtues, enriching the lives of those around them.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Jawad ibn Abd-Allah was the fifth rightly-guided caliph of Islam. The name Jawad carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Jawad served as caliph from 969 to 971 AD, and is considered one of the most just and fair rulers in Islamic history.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Jawad remains relevant in modern Muslim society, representing a bridge between traditional Islamic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Islamic names.

name_in_real_life.story: A successful entrepreneur named Omar Jawad in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia attributes much of their success to the blessing of their name Jawad, which means "Generous, Noble". They believe their name has shaped their identity and guided them through life.
